title: Prompts Live on an Arc: Gaussian Curricula in Fisher--Rao Coordinates for Rollout-Efficient GRPO
abstract: arXiv:2609.38018v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Group relative policy optimization (GRPO) learns only from prompts whose sampled responses disagree: a group that is entirely correct or entirely incorrect has zero reward variance, contributes no gradient, and still consumes its rollouts. Prompt-selection methods reduce this waste by steering sampling toward intermediate pass rates, but they choose the target, its width, and the uncertainty model heuristically, in raw pass-rate or logit coordinates. We show that GRPO comes with a natural coordinate for pass rates: the arc length $\psi=\arcsin\sqrt{p}$ on the Bernoulli Fisher--Rao manifold. In arc length, the expected GRPO update is uniform up to two boundary ramps; the probability of a zero-variance group is bounded by two Gaussian boundary layers of width $1/\sqrt{2G}$; pass-rate evidence has constant noise; and the gradients of the pass@$k$ and pass$^k$ objectives are Gaussians whose center and width follow from $k$ in closed form. A

translated_title: 提示词栖居于一条弧上：面向 Rollout 高效 GRPO 的 Fisher–Rao 坐标下的高斯课程
translated_abstract: 组相对策略优化（GRPO）只从那些采样响应存在分歧的提示词中学习：全部正确或全部错误的组奖励方差为零，不产生任何梯度，却仍然消耗其 rollout 采样。提示词选择方法通过将采样引导至中等通过率来减少这种浪费，但它们是在原始通过率或 logit 坐标中，以启发式的方式选择目标、目标宽度以及不确定性模型。我们证明 GRPO 自带一个通过率的天然坐标：伯努利 Fisher–Rao 流形上的弧长 ψ=arcsin√p。在弧长坐标下，GRPO 的期望更新除两个边界斜坡外是均匀的；零方差组出现的概率被两个宽度为 1/√(2G) 的高斯边界层所界定；通过率证据具有恒定的噪声；并且 pass@k 与 pass^k 目标的梯度是高斯分布，其中心和宽度可由 k 以闭式解给出。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现 GRPO 的通过率天然生活在伯努利 Fisher–Rao 流形的弧长坐标上，在该坐标下零方差组的概率与 pass@k/pass^k 梯度均呈高斯形态且中心和宽度可由 k 闭式给出，据此提出高斯式课程来选择提示词，从而实现 rollout 高效的 GRPO 训练。
en_tdlr: GRPO pass rates naturally live on the Fisher–Rao arc-length coordinate, where zero-variance groups and pass@k/pass^k gradients become Gaussians with closed-form centers and widths, enabling Gaussian curricula for rollout-efficient prompt selection in GRPO.
